items.title: Mini Lucky Blocks
items.creator: Ninja Block
items.description:
Live in a world where luck matters a lot, especially when lucky blocks are tiny.

- Mini lucky blocks
- Multiplayer
- By Irium Studio

items.title: Millionaire Mansion
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Wanna feel like a millionaire? What better way then experiencing the luxurious millionaire lifestyle. Explore the mansion and see what you can find. If you want to live like a millionaire then this is the perfect map for you.

- Stunning survival spawn
- By RareLoot

items.title: May 2021 Skins of the Month
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Wildflowers and sunflowers bloom as May grows wonderful new sights, including 14 sun-spotted skins from your friends at House of How. Float like a cloud and fly like a bee, fly like a bird (or pilot an airplane, also as a bird), or lounge around the house as a cat that is definitely not an alien. Definitely not.

items.title: Cat Nip
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
MEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOWWWWWWWWWWWWWWW!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Get help! These cats have had a little too much catnip and now they’re bouncing off the walls!!!
Do me a favor! Take care of these eight furry beasts before they meow and purr so much that this whole place explodes!

items.title: SCP Survival
items.creator: House of How
items.description: ALERT! Another cell of dangerous SCP experiments has escaped and it's your job to secure all entities before it's too late. 11 SCP skins. Guards and Class D personnel are standing by to help contain these monsters, unless...you're one of them?

items.title: Simple Spawns Bungalow Retreat
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
You’ve arrived at your vacation destination. A quiet, beach-side bungalow retreat. It’s time to kick back, relax and take in the sun. What a treat!

A comfy beachside town with plenty of bungalow-style accommodations for you to pick from.
Your own personal Yacht, docked at the private pier.
Share this vacation destination with your friends or enjoy it by yourself.

items.title: 10Minutes vs 10Hours vs 10Days
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Will you travel to a humble home thrown together in 10 minutes? A mansion that built 10 hours? Or the home desired by billionaires?
Who will be the lucky one to claim the house that takes 10 full days to create accompanied by a jet-ski and 3 supercars?!

- Jet-ski and 3 supercars!
- And much more!

items.title: City of Elysium
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
You are a daring adventurer who has sailed the seas to reach the shining City of Elysium. A beautiful merchant hub with a bustling market. You’ve traveled far and wide to make it here and make it BIG!

Beautiful ancient Roman & Greek-inspired architecture.
A comfortable vibrant city you can call home.
Adventures and secrets at every corner.

items.title: Simple Spawns: Blossom Village
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
A beautiful japanese inspired town nestled amongst lush vegetation. It’s peaceful here and the land is rich. A perfect place for a budding adventurer to create their new home hub!

A colorful village full of cherry blossom trees.
Marvels of architecture to explore.
A Palace filled with riches, just waiting for you to find them!

items.title: Slime Demons
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Slimes are everywhere so have fun with this incredible pack of demonic slime skins, with different colors to choose from.

- Ten skins beautiful.
- One skin totally free.
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Powerful Teens
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
One day you wake up wanting to be a young superhero who fights evil and helps their community. With this skinpack you can decide for yourself what hero you want to be and what superpowers you want to have. The decision is in your hands.

-Twelve skins.
-One skin totally free.
-Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Animal Onesies
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Cosy up as your favourite animal with these wonderful onesies!

*11 animal skins
*1 free skin

items.title: Survivors
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Are you tough as nails? Do you have no limits? Then this pack is the one for you! 

*12 survivors
*2 free skins

items.title: Daisy Daycare – Roleplay
items.creator: Pixelbiester
items.description:
Roleplay in a big daycare house with all you need for a happy child's life. Stay in one of the highly detailed rooms and choose from a big variety of toys. Play in the garden or jump in the pool. Take a jolly trip on the daycare bus. 

+ Easy way to place, rotate, and paint furniture
+ Several rideable vehicles
+ Funny bobby car race
+ Pet your fluffy dog or cat!

items.title: Neon Shadows Part 1
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Five fun designs in 3 different variants each in 5 colours.
Enjoy these bright neon skins and stand out from the crowd.

Two free skins!

items.title: Crewmates & Imposters
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
There is an imposter among us! It's up to the crewmates to find out who it is! Who in the group is the traitor? With these space skins you can go on a real adventure! Pick your favorite color and show others which skin you like the most! They are among us!

+Imposter skins!
+Crewmate skins!
+Amazing for roleplay!
+Amazing for YouTube videos!

items.title: Gogh's
items.creator: Dragnoz
items.description: A set of skins inspired by a great artist. So many colours all burning so bright.

items.title: Forest Mutation
items.creator: Dragnoz
items.description: Not all who wander are lost, some choose to wander and explore. Some choose to lay their head on a pillow of forest moss. But be aware, sleep too long and the forest will swallow you whole and mutate your body if not your soul.

items.title: They Live
items.creator: Dragnoz
items.description:
Hidden among us they live in the shadows. These chameleon-like entities can change the colour of their skin to hide and blend in. At night their outer layer tends to turn grey but their spots remain.

- 9 skins
- 4 grey with coloured spots

items.title: Neon City Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Get ready to explore the city in your brand new cozy neon clothing!

+ 12 neon teen skins
+ Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Noel Design.

items.title: Anime Ninjas
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Check out these cool anime ninjas!
Stand out from the crowd with these stylish skins. 
One free skin!

items.title: Ninja
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
The way of a ninja is sacred and beautiful. Even if hard times are ahead there will always be a ray of hope! With these skins you and your friends can roleplay as martial art masters!

- 11 ninja skins

items.title: Vikings of Old
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
With this skin pack you can become as a powerful Viking! Roleplay with your friends as goblins and werewolves. Start a wolf clan and team up with the werewolves against the Vikings!

- 6 Viking skins
- 4 monster skins

items.title: Doggy Dog
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Get ready to chase the mailman and bury your bones because today you've become a doggo! If you are a fan of those adorable canines then this dog themed skin pack is perfect for you!

- 11 dog skins
